items.q: What is BYX-MVP?
items.a: A desktop terminal with three workspaces: Trading for market observation, Research for the scientific pipeline, and BYX for the network, wallet, benefits and treasury.

items.q: Why is live trading off?
items.a: Live trading stays disabled while strategies are researched and validated. It cannot be turned on from Settings or any preference.

items.q: What do LOCALNET, TEST, PAPER and REAL mean?
items.a: LOCALNET is a development network. TEST assets have no financial value. PAPER is simulated capital. REAL is only shown for verified sources, and none are configured yet.

items.q: Where does market data come from?
items.a: ETHUSDT data comes from Binance USD-M Futures. Binance is the data source, not the operator of BYX-MVP.

items.q: Why do I see "Waiting for market data"?
items.a: The market feed is not connected yet. BYX-MVP never simulates prices, so values stay empty until real data arrives.

items.q: Can I place orders?
items.a: No. With live trading off, Positions and Orders stay empty and no order is sent.

items.q: What are TRAIN, VALIDATION and FINAL_HOLDOUT?
items.a: They are separate data partitions. Hypotheses are developed on TRAIN, checked on VALIDATION and confirmed once on FINAL_HOLDOUT.

items.q: Why is Validation locked?
items.a: The research guard keeps VALIDATION locked until the TRAIN stage is complete. FINAL_HOLDOUT stays sealed. The interface never overrides these gates.

items.q: What does Capture record?
items.a: Capture records market microstructure sessions for ETHUSDT from Binance USD-M Futures for research.

items.q: Can I start or stop capture from the app?
items.a: No. The app shows capture as read-only monitoring. Starting, stopping and recovery are handled outside the app.

items.q: What is BYX?
items.a: BYX is a blockchain built with Cosmos SDK. Its base denomination is ubyx, displayed as BYX with 6 decimals.

items.q: Why does the network say LOCALNET?
items.a: This build connects to a local development network. Everything on it is TEST and has no financial value.

items.q: What is the difference between a watch address and a verified wallet?
items.a: A watch address is read-only and anyone can add one. A verified wallet proves you control it by signing a challenge in your wallet. Verification moves nothing.

items.q: Does BYX-MVP store my private key?
items.a: No. Your private key and seed phrase stay in your wallet. BYX-MVP never asks for them, sees them or stores them.

items.q: How do I change my password?
items.a: Open Account, then Security, then Password.

items.q: How do I sign out other sessions?
items.a: Open Account, then Sessions, and choose Sign out other sessions.

items.q: What is admin verification?
items.a: Research requires an admin session. You confirm it with an email or SMS code after signing in.

items.q: What do diagnostics include?
items.a: Versions, environment and service status. Diagnostics never include passwords, tokens, session secrets, API keys, private keys, seed phrases or authorization headers.

items.q: The status dock says Backend offline
items.a: Other parts keep working. Wait for the dot to turn green, or open Help, then Diagnostics, to copy a report.

items.q: I am not receiving notifications
items.a: Check Settings, then Notifications. Security notifications cannot be turned off.
